result.summary: Found 1 issue: a broken/missing restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section displaying only a placeholder icon instead of the actual restaurant photo.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the first restaurant card is showing a generic image placeholder icon instead of the actual restaurant image, indicating the image failed to load or is missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL is correct and the image file is accessible. Implement proper image error handling with a fallback that either retries loading or displays a more appropriate default image with the restaurant name visible.
